query:
Two people observe that Adaeze saying 'it's fine' about the Christmas fund has become a recurring pattern and that the issue deserves to be put on the agenda properly. Which of the following made this specific observation — and what in how they expressed it distinguishes their message from the other person who said something similar immediately before?

Options:
A. Obiageli
B. Chisom
C. Nkechi
D. Ifeoma
context:
[1] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t10 @2025-11-23T18:48:00) Greetings. Adaeze. Thank you for saying this clearly. I have been waiting two years for you to stop saying it is fine. In our family, we have always believed that no one person should carry what belongs to everyone. Emeka has already offered. I suggest you formalise it this week. Do not leave it for January.
[2] (about=Chisom, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:31:00) Ada you always say it's fine and it is never fully fine though 😭 I see you
[3] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:25:00) Aunty Oby I appreciate that, genuinely. It's fine for now. Let's just get through this year and we can revisit the setup after. 😊
[4] (about=Ifeoma, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:28:00) Worth noting that 'fine for now' has been the answer for a couple of years. I think Aunty Oby is raising something real. Not pushing, just saying it should be on the agenda properly at some point. x
[5] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:35:00) My children, Adaeze carries too much and she does not complain. I am proud of her. We will discuss this properly in December. God willing, we will sort it out as a family. Chisom, have you confirmed your dates? I need to know if you will be there from the 24th.
[6] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t10 @2025-11-23T18:54:00) My children. This is good. Adaeze, I should have pressed harder sooner. I knew it was wearing on you. God willing, next year this will run differently. Thank you for speaking up. 🙏
[7] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t6 @2025-11-09T19:23:00) My children, Ifeoma is right. A standing order would save Adaeze having to send reminders every year. God willing, we should set that up in January. Adaeze, how much do we have so far? Is it enough for the usual gifts and the Christmas day food budget?
[8] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t10 @2025-11-23T18:44:00) okay so before we move on I need to say something about the Christmas fund. I love doing this but I genuinely need someone to share this with me this year - I nearly dropped it in November. six years is a long time to be doing the chasing and the reconciling alone. I'm asking properly now, not hinting. who will co-manage it with me from this December?
[9] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t6 @2025-11-09T19:33:00) Greetings my people. Six years. I have been watching Adaeze carry this and I will say it again in this chat, plainly: someone else in this family should be learning this process from her. Not next year. Now.
[10] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T15:45:00) Kingsley. A pre-Christmas gathering at your property is a separate matter. The Christmas Day gathering itself is family. I trust you understand the distinction I am making.
agent_answer:
The person who made this specific observation is **D. Ifeoma**.

Ifeoma said:

> “Worth noting that ‘fine for now’ has been the answer for a couple of years… just saying it should be on the agenda properly at some point.”

That combines both parts: the recurring “it’s fine” pattern and the need to put the matter on the agenda properly.

The other similar message came from **Chisom**:

> “Ada you always say it’s fine and it is never fully fine though 😭 I see you”

Chisom also noticed the recurring pattern, but expressed it more casually and emotionally, with the emoji, and did **not** explicitly say the issue should be put on the agenda. Ifeoma’s message is distinguished by its more formal framing and the explicit call for the issue to be on the agenda properly.
